All 14 queries ran and returned sensible answers. I checked T12 and T13 by hand against the CSV. I didn't check the others by hand.

- **Missing profiles (T3, T4):** `at :profile | at :country` and `at :profile | at :age` handle users with no profile. A plain `/profile` fails on them.
- **T6 assignee:** `at :assignee | at :login` gives null when the assignee is null or missing.
- **T10 keys:** the per-service counts print with keyword keys (`:db 3`), not quoted strings.
- **T14:** the sort uses a two-part key of length descending, then the word itself.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(/email | ne null) | filter ~(/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | map ~(lower) | contains "admin") | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | map ~(count)
T4: /data/users | map ~(at :profile | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(/labels | map ~(/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | at :login)})
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count)
T8: :p / | /dependencies | union (p | /devDependencies) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | map ~([(/0 | keyword) /1] | join "@")
T9: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) | map ~(count)
T11: lines | map ~(split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(/0 | split "=" | /1 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | map ~(mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) | map ~(map ~(mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2) | entries | sort ~(/1 | desc) | take 2 | map ~({:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1})
